text:
Error tracking is in place. It reports to your self-hosted GlitchTip instead of Sentry. I installed the SDK and the syntax check passes, but I haven't run the server or sent a test error.

Your GBrain notes say you self-host GlitchTip and rejected Sentry on 2026-10-28 because of cost. They also say the DSN lives in `GLITCHTIP_DSN`. GlitchTip accepts the Sentry SDK, so I used `@sentry/node` and pointed it at that DSN.

- **`src/instrument.js`** (new) initializes the SDK from `GLITCHTIP_DSN`. Without a DSN it does nothing, so local development still works. It sets `environment` from `NODE_ENV` and turns off performance tracing.
- **`src/server.js`** imports the new file first and registers the Sentry error handler after the routes. Express 5 passes rejected async handlers to that handler, so database failures in `/households/:id/lists` are reported.
- **`src/server.js` (fallback handler)** returns a plain `500 {"error":"Internal server error"}` to clients after reporting.
- **`package.json`** now depends on `@sentry/node`.

To check it, set `GLITCHTIP_DSN` and run `npm start`. Then hit the lists route with `DATABASE_URL` unset or wrong, and the error should appear at https://errors.larkfield.example.
